Q202.reason: Upright posture supports full inspiration and consistent peak flow measurements ([Asthma + Lung UK](https://www.asthmaandlung.org.uk/symptoms-tests-treatments/tests/peak-flow)).

Q203.reason: Extravasation is leakage of vesicant medication from a vein into surrounding tissue ([NCI](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-terms/def/vesicant-extravasation)).
